promptChange: For each team, write reason: one short line about why that team's own segments, in plain words.
Never write a number or a percent, and never say that a value rose, fell or changed: the plan already shows those.

findings: 6 of 6 runs ran on device as the SDK reported, with no request to a Google or Firebase host.
0 of 6 runs would fall back under a rule refusing any figure or rise or fall word in a reason: no reason held one.

0 of 12 reasons said anything true about its segment: every one gave the codes CC and CD a meaning they do not have (customer, content, product, complaints, order disputes), and one summary expanded them as Customer Contact (CC) and Customer Development (CD).
The prompt was not adopted; today's prompt and the per-team figure check stay.
